title: Issuing the Named Non-Owner Policy Renewal Offer
content:
The renewal offer premium rule prices the Named Non-Owner Policy renewal offer issued for an in-force term not being nonrenewed whose named insured's points do not exceed the package's renewal points, so that the package is kept; the renewal term starts on the expiring term's expiration date and runs the same number of months; a renewal moved to a lower package keeps the base renewal rule and is not priced by this rule.

The renewal offer premium is not fixed until the expiring term carries a package that accepts a DUI or DWI conviction within 60 months whenever the named insured has a DUI-related FR-44 Operator certificate requirement recorded.

A renewal offer is not issued before any increase charge owed for a package change made on the expiring term has been booked.

**What issuing creates.** The renewal term of the expiring term named: it keeps the policy number, named insured, residence state, term length, violation points and certificate backed of the expiring term, carries the term number one higher, points back to the expiring term, and is stamped with the day's issue date and the status renewal offered, carrying the package, full-term premium, opening day, closing boundary and number of days given, with no premium or fees yet booked. The insured then has a renewal offer on file, accepted by paying the renewal bill.

## Invocation: `issue_nonowner_renewal_offer_23563ff0`
An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_nonowner_renewal_offer_23563ff0` and calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nonowner_policy_id` | the reference number of the expiring Named Non-Owner Policy term being renewed, as returned by the non-owner policy lookup for the caller | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the package the renewal term carries | exactly one of the six values below |
| `renewal_full_term_premium` | the full-term premium of the renewal term, in US dollars | a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |
| `effective_date` | the opening day of the renewal term | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, no time or time zone |
| `expiration_date` | the date coverage under the renewal term ends at 12:01 a.m. | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, no time or time zone |
| `term_days` | the calendar days of the renewal term | an integer of 1 or more, whole days, no decimals |

| `variant_name` value | When it is the renewal's package |
|---|---|
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits" | the renewal carries the residence state's minimum limits without uninsured motorist cover beyond what the state mandates |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits with UM" | it carries the state minimum limits with uninsured motorist cover equal to them |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50" | it carries 50,000/100,000/50,000 limits |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50" | it carries 100,000/200,000/50,000 limits |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50" | it carries 100,000/300,000/50,000 limits |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100" | it carries 250,000/500,000/100,000 limits |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation naming the new renewal term reference number (prefix nrn_), the expiring term reference number it renews, the policy number, the term number as a whole number, the package, the full-term premium in US dollars with 2 decimals, the opening day and the expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD, the term days as a whole number and the status renewal offered. The presence of the new term reference number means the offer was issued.
